evals.prompt: My RAG answers keep quoting a skill file I deleted last week. Check whether the index has drifted and tell me what to do.
evals.expected_output: Runs the drift report, reads the stale chunk count, and recommends an action using the count thresholds.
assertions: Runs report.py from the rag-index directory and reads the stale-chunks summary
Maps the stale count to an action: under 5 wait, 5 to 20 fix incrementally, over 20 full rebuild
Deleted-file chunks are removed by path (DELETE FROM chunks WHERE path ...) after previewing the count
Re-runs the report and confirms stale count returned to baseline

evals.prompt: I rewrote old-auth.md in my standards folder but retrieval still returns the old text. Fix the stale chunks.
evals.expected_output: Treats this as modified-file drift and does an incremental reindex of just that file.
assertions: Identifies the case as a modified file, not a deleted one
Uses build.py --incremental on that single file path
Explains the reindex deletes old chunks then re-embeds, leaving other chunks untouched
Verifies by re-running the drift report

evals.prompt: The index has no document about our deploy runbook at all. Write one so queries find it.
evals.expected_output: This is a coverage gap (missing doc), not drift of stale chunks; belongs to rag-curate.
assertions: Does not run the drift report or delete chunks
Treats the task as authoring a missing document
Does not claim stale chunks are the cause
